notes.title: A New Update For Transylvania Drift is here!
notes.content:
Hello there mates! First, as always, I want to thank you for playing my game and for supporting me in my game development journey!

This update is not that big but it has a few additions and a few fixes!

Here are the changes:

- Added 2 new cars to the game, to be specific 2 taxis!
- Reduced the game's size to ~350mb!
- Fixed some textures blur in some cases!

Thank you for taking your time reading this patch note, have an awesome time and as always lots of health to you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466660/44a74061ea973d9ef3b300b85e256c5e9803c937.png[/img]

notes.title: A new special car is available in Transylvania Drift!
notes.content:
First I want to thank you all for playing and for supporting me in this game's development! In this update I wanted to make a special car for my Turkish players as they are the ones that play my game the most! So I just want to thank them and of course I want to thank all the players for playing my game and PC and Mobile aswell!

Here are the changes:
- Added a brand new car to the game: 1998 AyYildiz Efsane!
- The Zathmar Airport map got a brand new accessible area!
- Adjusted the cars handling so they can be used more easily and more stable
- Fixed some minor bugs in the map

Thank you once again for everything, and wishing you lots of health!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466660/cef7687883d751a4147e542d5e30c37cf37b9a54.png[/img]

notes.title: The first update for Transylvania Drift is here!
notes.content:
Thank you for all the support so far!
I've put together a new version of Transylvania Drift.
Here are the changes and additions:

- Added a brand new drift car to the car roaster!
- Fixed the Formula Racing car in the game so it's more controllable than before! Now it is possible to complete the "The Truest Racing Fiction!" achievement!

Thank you once again, wishing you a lot of health and happiness!
